TraverseApp.solve() calls resize() before its try block. Input parsing is detailed in 03a–03b; case detection in 03d. A raised TraverseError or ArithmeticError is caught by TraverseApp.solve().

Exceptions from InputModel.sides(), number(), detect_case(), case solvers, or candidate evaluation all propagate to the same TraverseApp.solve() catch. Unmatched exceptions are not caught there.
